title: Ocean zones template
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Habitats and blocking sound (Blue Abyss and Can We Block Sound?)
source: Seeded from science/y4 lesson 28 (Ocean zones template (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 28: Ocean habitats. To understand that the ocean has very different habitats from the shore to the deep sea

questions.q: A fish lives where it is dim, about 500 m down. Which zone?
questions.model: Use the table: 200 to 1,000 m is twilight. 500 m is between 200 and 1,000. So the twilight zone.

questions.q: What happens to light as you go deeper?
questions.a: It fades until it is dark

questions.q: Draw the ocean zones as three stripes. Label depth and light, and place three animals in the right zone.
questions.model: Teacher draws the sunlit stripe: '0 to 200 m, bright: seaweed and turtles'.

questions.q: Compare a coral reef and the deep sea in a table: light, warmth, plants.
questions.a: Reef: bright, warm, plants and algae; deep sea: dark, cold, no plants

questions.q: How do deep-sea animals get food with no plants?
questions.a: They eat food that sinks from above, or eat each other

questions.q: Big question: what changes as you dive deeper?
questions.a: Less light, colder, more pressure, no plants.
